findings.issue: inReadOnlyTransaction suppresses ROLLBACK failures, so export/verification can resolve successfully while retaining an open transaction and writer reservation. Independent actual-TS/node:sqlite fault injection reproduced the lock.
findings.remedy: Reject when rollback cleanup fails; propagate or safely wrap cleanup error. Document caller must close/discard the unusable connection. Add regressions for export, verification and cleanup while unwinding another error. No accounting/UI changes.
